text:
kevin (partnerships): Quick sync: DD asked if we can expose GPU-level telemetry in the marketplace tile (util, mem, temp, power). They want standard metric names so customers can build cost/heat dashboards. Can we add this to the JSON?

nina (eng-ml): We already emit per-GPU stats from the runtime (nvidia-dcgm -> OTLP). Names today are `gpu.utilization_pct`, `gpu.memory_used_mb`, `gpu.temperature_c`, `gpu.power_w`. Need to confirm units and labels.

ryan (eng-runtime): Confirmed. We push metrics to our collector with labels: node.id, gpu.index, model.name, model.version, route, and env. We can add `instance_type` (e.g., p4d, a100) too.

olga (eng-sre): Ops concern: sampling traces vs metrics retention. Metrics are high-cardinality if we keep model.version+route. Recommend aggregating at 1m for marketplace dashboard JSON and tag examples for drilling.

marco (devex): For the one-click dashboard JSON I'll include widgets: per-node GPU utilization heatmap, per-model memory usage, an anomaly monitor for temp>85C, and power/cost estimate (watt-hours * $/kWh). Need example derived metric for cost.

tara (dd-pdm): Great. For Datadog we prefer metric names with `redwood.` prefix to avoid collisions (e.g., `redwood.gpu.utilization_pct`). Also please include `cloud.provider` and `region` tags. For pricing widgets we can use a formula; can you include default $/kWh and per-GPU watt idle/avg numbers in the JSON?

kevin (partnerships): Add note: marketplace listing needs a short compliance blurb on telemetry — no PII, aggregate-only for metrics. Legal wants to review the blurb.

legal-bot: Reminder: telemetry copy must be under 200 words and include opt-out instructions. See policy doc: https://redwood.internal/legal/telemetry-policy.

nina (eng-ml): We'll strip any request-level text from metrics and traces. Traces keep model.id and route only, not prompt text. Will document this in quickstart.

olga (eng-sre): Proposed monitor thresholds (will include as suggested alerts in JSON):
- GPU util p95 > 90% for 5m -> warn
- GPU temp avg > 80C -> critical
- Memory used per-gpu > 95% -> warn
- power draw > expected_by_instance_type * 1.2 -> warn
I'll add example monitor JSON snippets.

marco (devex): Example derived metric snippet for cost estimator (to go into dashboard JSON):
```
derived_metric: redwood.gpu.cost_per_min = redwood.gpu.power_w * (cost_per_kwh / 60)
```
Will make it a dashboard variable so customers can override $/kWh.

tara (dd-pdm): That works. Also request: include a sample terraform snippet for Datadog provider that imports the dashboard so partners can automate installation.

kevin (partnerships): Timeline check: can we have draft dashboard + telemetry copy + quickstart by Mon (1799670000)? DD wants to QA before approval.

nina (eng-ml): Yes, I'll hand off metric naming + privacy notes by Fri (1799640000).

ryan (eng-runtime): I'll add `instance_type` tag and wire nvidia exporter mapping by Sat (1799646000).

marco (devex): I'll produce dashboard JSON + terraform snippet + example notebook by Mon (1799670000).

legal-bot: Logged: review request created (LR-2026). Expect response within 3 business days.

tara (dd-pdm): Perfect. Also for the marketplace tile metadata we need 2 screenshots (dashboard full, and one filtered by `model.name`). Can someone capture after draft is done?

olga (eng-sre): I can spin a sandbox run and capture screenshots. Will annotate with `env=sandbox`.

deploy-bot: ci/observability/gpu-metrics #412 job passed (dashboard lint, tf snippet check) :white_check_mark:

kevin (partnerships): Thanks team. I'll coordinate the Datadog QA call after we land the draft. Ping this thread when assets are uploaded. :rocket:
